subject: BuildWith 2027 — attendee lab access tokens request
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@buildwithconf.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: buildwith-support@events.co
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Promo token pool for attendee labs

Hi Kimberly and Marissa,

Thanks again for sponsoring the BuildWith attendee labs this year. Quick ask from our side — can Redwood provide a pool of promo/trial tokens for workshop attendees so they can try the platform during the hands-on sessions?

What we're hoping for:
- ~3k single-use tokens (or equivalent codes) that grant a 30-day trial with an elevated token allowance for lab exercises.
- Redemption window: Mar 20 — Apr 30 so attendees who miss the live session can still try later.
- Simple CSV we can distribute (one code per attendee) and a reporting hook so we can see redemption counts.

Attached is the sponsorship draft with the agreed deliverables. We need confirmation by Tue 3/16 so we can include the codes in the final attendee packet.

Any constraints on single-use vs multi-use codes? Budget considerations? Happy to flex.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Anna
Anna Lopez
Partnerships, BuildWith Conference
anna.lopez@buildwithconf.com

Attachment: BuildWith_Sponsorship_Draft.pdf

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@buildwithconf.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo token pool for attendee labs

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear ask and the draft. Confirmed that Redwood can support a pool for the attendee labs; a few operational questions before we finalize:

1) Pool size and tiers: is 3k the absolute target, or can we tier (e.g., 500 "instructor" elevated passes, 2,000 standard single-use trials, 500 follow-up extension codes)?
2) Redemption model: we can do single-use one-time codes (CSV) or a per-attendee access link (less ops overhead). Single-use codes will require us to generate a larger CSV and TTL.
3) Reporting: we can provide a post-event redemption report (counts by code) and a short usage summary (avg tokens consumed, top endpoints). If you need real-time redemption tracking embedded in your portal, we can discuss an event webhook for a small integration effort.
4) Expiration: we recommend a 60-day redemption window from day of distribution to give attendees time after sessions. Trials start at first redemption and will be 30 days by default.

From a budget control standpoint, finance prefers a soft cap. I'll loop Marcus and Ben to confirm the final pool size. If you can confirm expected unique attendees and any priority lists (speakers/instructors) we can map tiers.

If you're okay with our recommended approach (single-use codes, 60-day redemption, 30-day trial), I'll request ops to generate the CSV and attach sample codes for your packet.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo token pool for attendee labs

Looping internal ops & finance:

We can support single-use CSV codes — ops will create code namespaced to "buildwith2027" and include metadata (tier, expiry). Suggested production approach:
- Create 2,500 single-use codes by default (reduce risk of over-issuance).
- 250 instructor/in person elevated tokens (higher allowance).
- 30-day trial on first redeem, 60-day redemption window.
- Flag codes that can be exchanged for a one-time 30-day extension if attendee requests it from our CS team.

Marcus — any issues with 2,500 vs 3,000? Finance flagged a consumption risk if we go much higher, but we can open a small reserve to top-up if the event shows higher-than-expected uptake.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Partnerships Ops, Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo token pool for attendee labs

I recommend we finalize at 2,500 total: 2,250 attendee single-use codes + 250 elevated instructor codes. Ops please create the CSV and sample. Finance wants a small reserve of 250 additional codes (locked) that can be released if the event redeems >90% of the primary pool. We'll mark reserve codes with a special prefix.

I'll sign off once ops confirms the CSV template and the tracking fields (code, tier, issued_at, redeemed_at, email_if_provided). Also want automated export of redemption metrics on Apr 15 and May 5 so partnerships can share with BuildWith.

Ben — please review budget approval for the reserve top-up.

Marcus
Director, Partnerships Finance (acting)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@buildwithconf.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo token pool for attendee labs

Anna — good news, we have an approved plan. Summary and next steps: 

- Allocation: 2,500 total codes (2,250 attendee single-use; 250 instructor elevated).
- Redemption window: Mar 20 — May 19 (60 days from distribution).
- Trial length: 30 days from first redeem.
- Reserve: 250 locked codes for top-up; will be released only if primary pool redeems >90%.
- Deliverables: ops will generate a CSV named "promo_codes_sample.csv" for your packet and a final SOW PDF (attached). We will provide redemption reports on Apr 15 and May 5.

Action items for you: please confirm final attendee count and share any priority lists (speakers/instructors) by Wed 3/17 EOD so we can tag elevated codes. Once confirmed, ops will create the CSV and we will share a password-protected file via Drive.

Attachments: promo_codes_sample.csv (stub), SOW_BuildWith_Final.pdf (stub)

Thanks — excited to support the labs.

— Kimberly
